Faster, safer vaults, and every library up to date.

- Synced vaults open instantly: an encrypted copy on this device means
  unlocking and listing no longer wait on the network, and they work offline.
- Session lists load in one step instead of one request per session.
- Fixed a crash that could happen on Windows when a vault closed.
- Every library Reach is built on is on its latest version, closing all the
  known security issues in them, including 12 in the SSH library.
- Remote desktop runs on the newest IronRDP.
- Your vault, saved logins and known servers carry over untouched.

Full details: https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
